description: Grip — the source-of-truth grip layer as content. Registers the `fact` document type (subject/quantity/claim/evidence/rerun/level/observed_at/deps) and walls its PUBLISH path: a fact whose `rerun` command fails the fail-closed screen, or whose claimed `level` sits above the level that command derives, cannot publish. Schemas-only: the generic query endpoint serves it, no bespoke routes.
